pages.text: The Super Generator Core is the 5x5x5 multiblock version of the Chi Energy Generator:$(br)place the core in the center and surround it with 124 Chi Energy Generators in a 5x5x5 to form the structure.$(br)Once formed it burns at 200x the single generator rate (15000/t), with total fuel energy exactly x3 of a single generator.$(br)Right-click any shell generator or the center to operate; connect pipes to any shell to export energy.
